figs.name: voting-architectures-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose 1oo1, 1oo2, 2oo2 or 2oo3 voting logic in a safety instrumented system
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how the required SIL and the cost of spurious trips lead to a 1oo1, 1oo2, 2oo2 or 2oo3 voting architecture.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to select a voting architecture for a safety instrumented function</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Choosing a Voting Architecture</text>
<rect x="240" y="56" width="320" height="50" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="87.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Required SIL for the SIF</text>
<line x1="400" y1="106" x2="400" y2="124" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,126.0 580.0,182 400,238.0 220.0,182" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="177.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">High consequence</text>
<text x="400" y="199.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">SIL 2 or SIL 3?</text>
<line x1="220" y1="182" x2="175" y2="182" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="197" y="170" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polygon points="95,134.0 175.0,182 95,230.0 15.0,182" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95" y="177.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Trip</text>
<text x="95" y="198.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">averse?</text>
<line x1="95" y1="230" x2="95" y2="262" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="110" y="252" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="20" y="262" width="150" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95.0" y="289.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1oo1</text>
<text x="95.0" y="313.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">lowest cost</text>
<polyline points="15,182 6,182 6,380 20,380" fill="none" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="20" y="350" width="150" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95.0" y="377.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2oo2</text>
<text x="95.0" y="401.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">uptime first</text>
<text x="24" y="342" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<line x1="400" y1="238" x2="400" y2="270" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="260" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<polygon points="400,274.0 580.0,330 400,386.0 220.0,330" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="325.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Spurious trips</text>
<text x="400" y="347.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">costly too?</text>
<line x1="580" y1="330" x2="620" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="600" y="318" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="622" y="295" width="160" height="70" rx="10" fill="#312e81" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="702.0" y="324.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2oo3</text>
<text x="702.0" y="348.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">balanced</text>
<line x1="400" y1="386" x2="400" y2="418" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="408" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="300" y="418" width="200" height="66" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="445.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1oo2</text>
<text x="400.0" y="469.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">safety first</text>
<text x="400" y="528" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Never use 2oo2 to claim a high SIL target</text>
</svg>

figs.name: voting-architectures-pfd-comparison-infographic
figs.alt: simplified PFD comparison of 1oo1, 1oo2, 2oo2 and 2oo3 voting architectures
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing simplified PFD values for 1oo1, 1oo2, 2oo2 and 2oo3 with a single channel PFD of 0.01, ignoring common cause failure.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Simplified PFD comparison of voting architectures for a single channel PFD of 0.01</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Simplified PFD with Single Channel PFD = 0.01</text>
<rect x="25" y="70" width="175" height="290" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="112" y="110" font-size="26" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1oo1</text>
<text x="112" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">p</text>
<text x="112" y="230" font-size="24" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.01</text>
<text x="112" y="300" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Baseline</text>
<text x="112" y="324" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<rect x="215" y="70" width="175" height="290" rx="14" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="302" y="110" font-size="26" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1oo2</text>
<text x="302" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">p²</text>
<text x="302" y="230" font-size="24" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.0001</text>
<text x="302" y="300" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">100 times</text>
<text x="302" y="324" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">safer</text>
<rect x="405" y="70" width="175" height="290" rx="14" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="492" y="110" font-size="26" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2oo2</text>
<text x="492" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2p minus p²</text>
<text x="492" y="230" font-size="24" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.0199</text>
<text x="492" y="300" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">About 2 times</text>
<text x="492" y="324" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">worse</text>
<rect x="595" y="70" width="175" height="290" rx="14" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="682" y="110" font-size="26" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2oo3</text>
<text x="682" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3p² minus 2p³</text>
<text x="682" y="230" font-size="24" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.000298</text>
<text x="682" y="300" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">About 34 times</text>
<text x="682" y="324" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">safer</text>
<text x="400" y="405" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">p = probability that one channel fails dangerously on demand</text>
<text x="400" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Simplified: ignores common cause failure and test interval effects</text>
<text x="400" y="475" font-size="18" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lower PFD means a safer architecture</text>
</svg>
